notes.title: Table Setup
items: Difficulty: Standard
Investigators: Lily Chen, George Barnaby, Trish Scarborough

notes.title: Opening Notes
items: Lily Chen's opening deck includes In the Thick of It, so she starts the campaign with 3 XP and chooses to take 2 total trauma as 1 physical trauma and 1 mental trauma.

storyNotes.title: Scenario I: The Pit of Despair

notes.title: Opening Events
items: George Barnaby, Lily Chen, and Trish Scarborough woke in a cold, wet cavern with no memory of the recent past and only fragments of identity intact.
The chamber appeared to be a natural cave formation that had recently been underwater, with kelp, slick stone, a slab of strange metal overhead, and an awful croaking sound echoing from the tunnels.
The scenario introduced flashbacks and colored keys, and the recovered memories became the first pieces of the larger Innsmouth mystery.

notes.title: Flashbacks
items: Flashback I record added: a meeting with Thomas Dawson.
Flashback II record added: a battle with a horrifying devil. Remove 1 cultist token from the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.
Flashback III record added: a decision to stick together. Remove 1 tablet token from the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.
Flashback IV record added: an encounter with a secret cult. Remove 1 elder thing token from the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.

notes.title: The Investigators Achieved Resolution I.
items: The investigators reached Resolution I at the end of the scenario.
George Barnaby, Lily Chen, and Trish Scarborough resigned.
Agent Harper found the investigators after they escaped the pit, but they still had no clear memory of how they reached Innsmouth or why the sky had turned crimson.
Each investigator earned 2 XP from the victory display. This experience is recorded as unspent experience and should not be spent yet.
Proceed to Interlude I: Puzzle Pieces.

notes.title: Puzzle Pieces
items: Agent Harper questioned the investigators about the memories they recovered and explained that it was September 24, with Innsmouth locked down and the tide rising around them.
Because a meeting with Thomas Dawson was recovered, the conspiracy deepens and each investigator records 1 additional unspent XP.
Because a battle with a horrifying devil was recovered, the conspiracy deepens and each investigator records 1 additional unspent XP.
Because a decision to stick together was recovered, the conspiracy deepens and each investigator records 1 additional unspent XP.
Because an encounter with a secret cult was recovered, the conspiracy deepens and each investigator records 1 additional unspent XP.
Each investigator has 6 unspent XP from Scenario I plus Interlude I.
Proceed to Scenario II: The Vanishing of Elina Harper.

metaItems: Session: Scenario II + Interlude II + Scenario III

storyNotes.title: Scenario II: The Vanishing of Elina Harper

notes.title: Opening Search
items: On Wednesday, August 17, 1927, five weeks before the pit, Agent Dawson drove George Barnaby, Lily Chen, and Trish Scarborough into Innsmouth to find Agent Elina Harper.

Dawson found Harper's abandoned vehicle near the old railroad station, but it offered no clear trail. With little to go on, he split the team up to canvas the town and learn who might know where Harper had gone.

The first useful contact was Joe Sargent, the suspicious bus driver in the town square. Through his curt tour of local gossip, the investigators learned the main names and places shaping Innsmouth's power structure: Brian Burnham at the First National grocery, Othera Gilman and the Gilman House, Joyce Little's bookshop, Barnabas Marsh's refinery, Zadok Allen near the old Fish Street bridge, Robert Friendly at the harbor, and the Esoteric Order of Dagon on New Church Green.

The town itself felt hostile from the start: abandoned buildings, watchful locals, and Dawson's growing worry all pointed to Harper having drawn attention from people who controlled more of Innsmouth than they admitted.

notes.title: Harper's Trail
items: That night, Dawson revealed that Harper had been staying at the Gilman House and had left behind an unsent letter warning that someone in town knew her movements.
The letter made the search urgent: Harper had not used Dawson's code phrase for a routine absence, so Dawson assumed she was in danger rather than merely lying low.
Together, the investigators narrowed the search to a suspect and a hideout, using the Leads deck to rule out impossible options before making an accusation.

notes.title: Leads Eliminated
items: Eliminated suspects: Robert Friendly, Joyce Little, Barnabas Marsh, Zadok Allen.
Eliminated hideouts: Innsmouth Jail, The House on Water Street, Sawbones Alley, New Church Green.

notes.title: The Accusation
items: The investigators accused Othera Gilman and searched Shoreward Slums.
The hidden Suspect was Brian Burnham and the hidden Hideout was Esoteric Order of Dagon.
Because neither part of the accusation matched the hidden cards, the investigators were on the wrong track and had to resign immediately.

notes.title: Scenario Outcome
items: No resolution was reached during play, and the aftermath proceeded through Resolution 1.
After the failed search, the investigators returned to their hotel room and found it ransacked, their gear stolen, and a warning left for them: INTERLOPERS DROWN IN THE DEEP.

A mysterious notebook slipped under the door gave them a new lead into Innsmouth's older history, Obed Marsh, and the Esoteric Order of Dagon. The notes suggested that whatever had happened to Harper was tied to the Order's deeper interests, not merely to smuggling or prohibition.
Campaign Log record: the mission failed.
Each investigator earned 3 XP from the victory display. This XP has been spent in the recorded Scenario II deck upgrades.
Proceed to Interlude II: The Syzygy.

notes.title: Memory Returns
items: The investigators came to on the rocky shore with Agent Harper standing over them, once again caught between the present-day Innsmouth crisis and the memories from five weeks earlier.
Because the mission failed, they remembered searching for Harper but never finding her, with the notebook about the Esoteric Order of Dagon as the last clear piece of the trail.

notes.title: Harper's Explanation
items: Harper revealed that she had escaped captivity on her own, though she was badly injured in the process.

She admitted that she was the one who slipped the notebook under the hotel room door. She could not safely stay and talk because she was still being followed, but she believed the investigators had uncovered more in one week than she had in two.

The conversation confirmed that the earlier failed search was still useful: the notebook and the investigators' work had pointed them toward the Esoteric Order of Dagon and the deeper conspiracy behind Harper's disappearance.

notes.title: The Syzygy
items: As Harper began to fill in the missing pieces, thunder rolled across the horizon and a powerful wave struck the jetties.
The sky turned crimson as storm clouds gathered around the aligned sun and moon, making it clear that the strange celestial event had begun.
Harper changed the plan immediately: the investigators would return to Innsmouth with her while she explained what she knew on the way.
Proceed to Scenario III: In Too Deep.

notes.title: Return To Innsmouth
items: Harper led George Barnaby, Lily Chen, and Trish Scarborough back toward Innsmouth while the sea continued to rise and the sun and moon aligned over the horizon.
As the gaps in their memories began to close, Harper explained that the hostile locals and the creatures in town seemed connected to the Esoteric Order of Dagon.

From the headland, the investigators saw that Innsmouth had been invaded. Deep One creatures prowled the flooded streets, barricades blocked the routes through town, and the Manuxet River had spilled out into the roads.
The group decided to cross town quickly and reach Agent Dawson's vehicle near the abandoned railway station on the western edge of Innsmouth.

notes.title: Flashbacks
items: Flashback V record added: a deal with Joe Sargent. Put the set-aside Joe Sargent asset into play under the control of an investigator at Innsmouth Square.
Flashback VIII record added: a jailbreak. Remove 1 elder thing token from the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.
Flashback VI record added: a followed lead. George Barnaby earns Teachings of the Order.
Flashback VII record added: an intervention. Add 1 +1 token to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.

notes.title: The Investigators Achieved Resolution I.
items: George Barnaby, Lily Chen, and Trish Scarborough all resigned and made it safely to the vehicles.
Harper recognized that leaving Innsmouth would not be enough: the rising tide, the aligned sky, and the creatures in town suggested a threat that could spread beyond Innsmouth if ignored.
Dawson's silver key turned up among the investigators' belongings, allowing Harper to start his automobile and escape the flooded town.
Campaign Log record: the investigators made it safely to their vehicles.
Each investigator earned 5 XP from the victory display plus 2 bonus XP because the investigators made it safely to their vehicles.
This 7 XP is recorded under Unspent Experience and should not be spent yet.
Proceed to Scenario IV: Devil Reef.

storyNotes.title: Scenario IV: Devil Reef
statusChips: Outcome: The Terror of Devil Reef is dead

notes.title: Voyage To Devil Reef
items: On Friday, September 2, 1927, three weeks before the present crisis, George Barnaby, Lily Chen, and Trish Scarborough hired Captain Moore to take them from Innsmouth to Devil Reef.
Because the mission to find Harper had failed, Agent Dawson boarded with the grim news that all four leads were cold and Harper was still beyond their reach.

The investigators chose Devil Reef anyway: sailors whispered about haunted coves, misshapen fins, vanished boats, and creatures crawling in and out of the reef caves. Dawson suspected the Esoteric Order of Dagon was spreading the rumors because it had something to hide there.

Before departure, Dawson asked why the investigators stayed in Innsmouth after failing to rescue Harper. They could only answer that duty, curiosity, or both had left them with no choice but to keep digging.

notes.title: Flashbacks
items: Flashback X record added: discovery of an unholy mantle. Take control of the white key and the set-aside Awakened Mantle story asset; place the white key on Awakened Mantle.
Flashback XI record added: discovery of a mystical relic. Take control of the black key and the set-aside Headdress of Y'ha-nthlei story asset; place the black key on Headdress of Y'ha-nthlei.
Flashback IX record added: discovery of a strange idol. Take control of the purple key and the set-aside Waveworn Idol story asset; place the purple key on Waveworn Idol.

notes.title: The Investigators Achieved Resolution I.
items: As daylight faded and the tide rose around Devil Reef, the investigators returned safely to shore with their discoveries.

The coves and tidal caverns held more than relics of the Esoteric Order of Dagon: they were home to strange fish-human hybrids, blood-stained altars, unholy prayers, and signs of a catastrophe still coming for Innsmouth and perhaps far more than Innsmouth.
Resolution 1 was not reached by advancing Agenda 2b.
Each investigator earned 5 XP from the victory display. This experience is recorded as unspent experience and should not be spent yet.
The Terror of Devil Reef was in the victory display, so the Campaign Log records that the Terror of Devil Reef is dead.
Do not move the purple, black, or white keys from their current positions yet; their locations will matter during Interlude III: Beneath the Waves.
Proceed to Interlude III: Beneath the Waves.

notes.title: Another Memory Surfaces
items: On the road back toward the present crisis, the investigators remembered a dark cell, a knife at their throat, and hooded figures discussing what they had stolen from Dagon's lair and Devil Reef.
A name surfaced from the vision: Oceiros. Harper identified him as Oceiros Marsh, keeper of the old lighthouse on Falcon Point.
The vision made it clear that the items found at Devil Reef had been taken from the investigators after their capture and sent to the lighthouse.

notes.title: Keys And Relics
items: Because the purple key was controlled or on the current act when Devil Reef ended, the idol was brought to the lighthouse. Each investigator earned 2 additional XP, and 1 cultist token was added to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.

Because the white key was controlled or on the current act when Devil Reef ended, the mantle was brought to the lighthouse. Each investigator earned 2 additional XP, and 1 tablet token was added to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.

Because the black key was controlled or on the current act when Devil Reef ended, the headdress was brought to the lighthouse. Each investigator earned 2 additional XP, and 1 elder thing token was added to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.
Do not add the Waveworn Idol, Awakened Mantle, or Headdress of Y'ha-nthlei story assets to any investigator deck yet. They must be recovered first.

notes.title: Toward Falcon Point
items: Harper recognized that the recovered memories were returning in fragments, but the lighthouse now seemed to be the next place with answers.
Thomas Dawson is returned to the collection. If an investigator earned Elina Harper earlier in the campaign, that investigator may add her back to their deck.

With a fragment of memory restored, the investigators may now spend the experience previously recorded under Unspent Experience. The group has spent that experience, so the Campaign Log no longer keeps an Unspent Experience entry.
Proceed to Scenario V: Horror in High Gear.

storyNotes.title: Scenario V: Horror in High Gear
statusChips: Outcome: Reached Falcon Point before sunrise

notes.title: The Road To Falcon Point
items: George Barnaby, Lily Chen, and Trish Scarborough sped along the old dirt roads outside Innsmouth with Agent Harper in the passenger seat, following her map toward Falcon Point Lighthouse.
Harper believed Oceiros Marsh could be found at the lighthouse. The name stirred a terrible memory: Oceiros was the man who had left the investigators to die in the tidal tunnels.

The winding roads made Falcon Point difficult to reach, and headlights soon appeared in the rearview mirror. The Order had already discovered the investigators' escape from Innsmouth and was closing in fast.
With Harper holding on beside them, the investigators accelerated into the night and tried to lose their pursuers before the sun rose.

notes.title: The Investigators Achieved Resolution I.
items: George Barnaby, Lily Chen, and Trish Scarborough survived the chase and reached the distant beacon of Falcon Point Lighthouse.
To keep anyone at the lighthouse from hearing their approach, Harper suggested pulling over and completing the rest of the journey on foot.
After checking that they were no longer being followed, the investigators gathered their belongings from the automobile and began the trek toward Falcon Point.
Campaign Log record: the investigators reached Falcon Point before sunrise.
Each investigator earned 7 XP from the victory display. This experience is reflected in the recorded Scenario V deck upgrades.
No investigator suffered physical or mental trauma.
Proceed to Scenario VI: A Light in the Fog.

storyNotes.title: Scenario VI: A Light in the Fog
statusChips: Outcome: All investigators resigned at the Moon Room

notes.title: Arrival At Falcon Point
items: Crimson-tinted fog covered the sky as George Barnaby, Lily Chen, Trish Scarborough, and Agent Harper reached the gatehouse of Falcon Point.
The lighthouse beacon cut through the mist above the cliffs, though the investigators doubted that any ships remained at sea in the worsening weather.
The evidence taken from them weeks earlier was somewhere inside, along with Oceiros Marsh, the man who had captured them and left them to die in the tidal tunnels.
With no safe escape route if the assault went wrong, Harper warned the investigators to be ready for anything. They pressed onward toward the cliffs, determined to end the matter that night.

notes.title: Key Representations Read
items: White: a pocket telescope.
Yellow: a heavy iron ring crowded with prison cell keys.
Purple: the deceased larva of a malformed fish.
Black: a map of the depths beneath Devil Reef.
Blue: a key carved with a symbol of an engorged fish eye.
Green: a fist-sized cluster of raw peridot that pulses and glows with unnatural light.
Red: a gilded key made of coral and covered in strange, glowing runes; the word Y'ha-nthlei is inscribed upon the handle.

items: Flashback XII record added: a conversation with Mr. Moore. Remove 1 elder thing token from the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.
Flashback XIII record added: the lifecycle of a "Deep One". Remove 1 tablet token from the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.

Each investigator who resigned at the Moon Room records that they possess a diving suit.
The black key was on the current act when the game ended, so the Campaign Log records that the investigators possess a map of Y'ha-nthlei.
The red key was on the current act when the game ended, so the Campaign Log records that the investigators possess the key to Y'ha-nthlei.

George Barnaby earns Awakened Mantle.
Trish Scarborough earns Headdress of Y'ha-nthlei.
Each investigator earned 6 XP from the victory display. Record this under Unspent Experience, but do not spend it yet.
